_purpose: Shared rules inherited by every vault spec via parent_entity. The vaults differ in form; this holds what they have in common, plus the three states (dormant, listening, awake).

canon: vaults transmit symbolic content when alignment conditions are met (vault pages)
Zone Theta and Vault 002 prose: curved planes with no edges, no door, the wall folds into itself, triple curve and circle
shared colour code in the style presets: blue observation, gold clarity, violet grief, cyan active resonance
proposed_needs_author_approval: stating these as rules for all ten vaults (author asked for a consistent intent across different forms, 2026-11-17)
_provenance.approved: Author approved the shared intent and the first four vault looks built on it (Giza vault, Veil exterior and interior, Fracture Well), 2026-11-18. Vaults 005 to 010 not yet rendered.
